Dr Elvira Sterinberg
Gynaecologist
123 Church St
Richmond 3121

02/02/2007

Re: Mrs Larissa Zaneeta, aged 38 years

Dear Dr Sterinberg,

Thank you for seeing Mrs Zaneeta, a married 38-year-old marketing manager and the mother of a
four-year-old boy, who has complaints of infertility. I am referring her for your specialist advice.   Commented [ms1]: to


Since 11/07/2005, Mrs Zaneeta has been experiencing stress-related anxiety due to her workload.
Despite being advised about relaxation techniques and being prescribed sleeping tablets, her
condition has not improved. Being Uunable to get pregnant, her anxiety is only worsening, and she      Commented [ms2]: did not improve
has expressed a fear that she is too old to conceive.                                                  Commented [ms3]: worsened
                                                                                                       Commented [ms4]: was: reported speech
Mrs Zaneeta has stopped taking oral contraceptive pills since April 2006. However, she has not
been able to conceive until now. I have discussed the nature of conception with her and reassured
her that it takes time and patience. Additionally, she was counselled regarding the frequency of
sexual intercourse and how to detect the time of ovulation. Three weeks ago, a pelvic examination
was performed with a Pap smear taken and Valium was prescribed twice daily.

Mr Zaneeta was assessed two weeks ago. His libido, erection and sperm count were normal, and he
was supportive of having a new child as well. Consequently, I would be grateful if you could
furtherly evaluate and manage Mrs Zaneeta’s condition.

Should you have any further queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely

Doctor
